concurrency_cases.name: E1_FOUR_PROCESS_INGESTION
concurrency_cases.invariant: 40 semantic inputs create exactly one durable run record and one state authority

R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.evidence: Current uncommitted Mac patch rejects a missing store entry, mismatched identities, unapproved and consumed gates.
R01-FORGED-HUMAN-GATE-RESUME.remaining_risk: approve_gate has no human-decision authority, store I/O is non-atomic and relative to cwd, and corruption is converted to an empty store.

R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.evidence: record_review still performs load/dedupe/save without a process-wide transaction lock.
R02-CONCURRENT-REVIEW-LEDGER.remaining_risk: Two processes can both report accepted review while one durable ledger record is lost.
